violation_type.title: Safety - Hinged Lid Storage Containers Safe (26 TAC §747.3501(7))
violation_type.short_title: Safety - Hinged Lid Storage Containers Safe
violation_type.typical_finding: I observed a storage container in the outdoor play area that was accessible to children and did not have a hinged lid.

finding_variants.text: I observed a storage container in the outdoor play area that was accessible to children and did not have a hinged lid.
Caregiver has an open storage chest with no safety latch to free a child if a child was to get inside. This was corrected at inspection, caregiver placed a lock on the storage chest.
